title: ChipAgent The Full Stack: Past the Demo
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

AI for semiconductor design can look impressive in a demo, but what does it take to make agentic AI work in real-world chip design and verification workflows?

In The Full Stack: Past the Demo, ChipAgents tech expert discusses the realities of deploying AI for semiconductor engineering, including:

• Why traditional AI benchmarks fall short for complex, long-horizon engineering tasks
• How agentic AI approaches coverage closure, formal verification, debugging, and root cause analysis
• How AI can capture institutional knowledge and understand legacy semiconductor codebases
• What it takes to deploy AI securely and reliably across production engineering teams
• How close collaboration between engineers and AI can compress month-long workflows into days
• Why the future of semiconductor design requires an AI-native EDA workflow

Watch for the video interview to learn how ChipAgents make AI work reliably for complex design flows from intent to tape-out.
